$provenance.note: The workbook's sample data, not the owner's. Read with openpyxl data_only=True (cached values). Plan S15b: the Paycheck view under F15 option B.

$semantics.schedule: F15 B finds the period from a pay schedule; the workbook types it (D18). D6 is 2025-01-01, noted 'Type in the Date you received your paycheck!', and D7 is 2025-01-14, noted 'Type in the Date prior to your next paycheck! (example: bi-weekly pay = 2 weeks after Start Date)'. So the window is the bi-weekly period of a payday on 2025-01-01, and the schedule here is that one. START HERE!C8 (2025-01-10, Bi-weekly) is not used: Paycheck never reads it, and its period holding D6 runs 2024-12-27 to 2025-01-09.
$semantics.cells: Only cells that hold under both D5 and F15 B. R10, X10 and X22 are SUMIFS over the window (F4); R9, X9, X21 their block totals; P6 =R9 and V6 =X9 the income and saved that D15 reads. X24 is 0 because Clothing's $100 on 2025-01-17 is in the next period, and L24 (=K52) is 0 because Car Loan's $100 on 2025-01-15 is too, and it has no Monthly Amount (Bills!H9 blank).
$semantics.left out: E22, E21, C19 (Rent, due day 1 in the window: the workbook 800, F15 B its share, 369.23), R22, R21, P19 (Netflix, due day 23 outside it: the workbook 0, F15 B 8.30), L22, L21, J19 (Credit Card 1: the workbook 250, D5 200), D11 and D15 (built from those), every typed budget and goal (Q10:Q16, W10:W16, D22:W44) and what subtracts them (Y10, Y9, Y22, Y21, D13: F15 B splits the month's budgets instead), D9 (no balance is typed for a period), and the hidden month block E50:R73, which the Paycheck view does not show (E50, R50 and L52 are workbook-month and workbook-period cells). Trivial zeros in rows 11-16 and 23-44 are not transcribed.
$semantics.planHistory: D13, as in workbook-week: the workbook's one Monthly Amount is typed as a row from 2025-01, the payday's month.
$semantics.budgetHistory: None: the month tabs' budgets are typed for 2026, and none is in effect in January 2025. No asserted cell reads one.
$semantics.signs: D3: spending, savings and logged payments are negated in the ledger; income stays positive.
$semantics.minimum: Only the categories that the rows, the monthly amounts and the asserted cells name, and only the rows dated in January 2025, the payday's month. A list's other rows are 0 in every asserted cell. Each keeps its START HERE position as its sort order.
$semantics.merchants: The engine takes no merchant text; no Notes column is transcribed. Ids are synthetic.
